title: Guided reading: Mark 1:15
subtitle: Read proclamation language without pretending every form is already mastered.
overview: This verse contains perfect forms you will study fully later. For now, identify the article–noun phrases, connectors, and imperatives you can already parse.
Good reading includes marking a form as “not yet mastered” rather than inventing a confident explanation.

sections.title: What you can parse now
rows: believe in the gospel — imperative + phrase

items.grc: πεπλήρωται ὁ καιρὸς καὶ ἤγγικεν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ.
items.en: The time has been fulfilled and the kingdom of God has drawn near.

items.grc: μετανοεῖτε καὶ πιστεύετε ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ.
items.en: Repent and believe in the gospel.
